title: Your first loop
starter:
# y[i] = 2 * x[i] for every i in 0..3. The starter only does i = 0, without a loop.
%x  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=0
%y  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=1
%xv = shrink %x 0 shape=[]
%xe = load %xv
%d  = mul %xe 2.0
%yv = shrink %y 0 shape=[]
%s  = store %yv %d
%y1 = after %y %s

samples.label:
buffer slot 0 starts as [1.0 2.0 3.0 4.0]
final contents of slot 1

hints: Replace the constant offset 0 with a range: `%i = range 4`, then use `%i` as the offset of both views.
The store now depends on `%i`, so it has to be closed: `%e = end %s %i`, and the top-level `after` takes `%e` instead of `%s`.

answer.code:
%x  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=0
%y  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=1
%i  = range 4
%xv = shrink %x %i shape=[]
%xe = load %xv
%d  = mul %xe 2.0
%yv = shrink %y %i shape=[]
%s  = store %yv %d
%ei = end %s %i
%y1 = after %y %ei
answer.explain: One range, two views offset by it, one store, one end, one after. The 3e38 test overflows to inf when doubled, and the subnormal doubles exactly, so the f32 rounding is checked too.
